parameters.question: Compare linear regression evaluation metrics (MSE, RMSE, MAE, R2) from LOOCV and an 80-20 train-test split. LOOCV metrics are deterministic and must match the reference within 5% relative absolute error. Train-test split metrics depend on the random split, so they need not match the reference; they only need a positive R2 and MSE, RMSE and MAE that agree with each other (RMSE = sqrt(MSE)). Column order and header labels may differ.
